column1: # gpu/nvidia/checks/checks.tsv: the checks gpu/nvidia/checks/gate.om runs, one per line: NAME TABLE PART...
# (single spaces). The parts are concatenated in order into one program: the gpu/ units under test, then
# gpu/nvidia/checks/lib.om (OM-1, so it composes with units of either profile), then, only when the first unit
# is OM-2, gpu/nvidia/checks/lib-om2.om, then the check. tests/gates/run.sh gpu-checks requires the exact count.
